newsitem.title: USA: Geographics Inc sees fiscal 1997 loss.
newsitem.headline: Geographics Inc sees fiscal 1997 loss.

text.p: Geographics Inc on Thursday said it expected to report a loss for the fiscal year ended March 31 of at least $6.5 million, compared with a profit of $1.2 million in the prior year.

The company, which makes stationery and graphic arts products, also said it expected full-year revenues to rise to about $24 million from $22.6 million. It sees fourth-quarter revenues falling to $5 million from $6.1 million in the year-ago quarter.
The expected loss reflects a decline in gross margin and an planned asset writedown of $500,000 to $750,000, it said.
The asset writedown relates to the company's information systems, a reserve to account for potentially obsolete inventory and other matters.
